card: Backports Guix build configuration fixes from master to the 32.x maintenance branch. It resolves native build failures on RISC-V hardware and fixes Python 3.12 build dependencies in Guix (backporting fixes from PRs #36233 and #36425, fixing issue #36232 for 32.x). This allows release signers on RISC-V systems to build deterministic binaries for the 32.x release.
evidence: PR description: 'These backports re-enable building release binaries on RISC-V hardware.'
Commit a5e6a09956: 'This is necessary to unblock building on RISC-V systems. Fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36232.'
Backports commits from master PRs #36233 and #36425.
problem: Release builders cannot build 32.x binaries natively on RISC-V hardware due to broken Guix packages and package tests, as well as Python 3.12 compatibility issues with setuptools and certvalidator.

risk.why: Mistakes in Guix build configurations could produce non-deterministic release binaries or fail the deterministic build process during release builds.

scope_notes: Clean backport bundle of four commits from PR #36233 and PR #36425 targeting the 32.x release branch.
summary: Backports Guix build configuration updates from master to the 32.x maintenance branch. It bumps the Guix time-machine commit, skips tests that fail when building natively on riscv64, explicitly declares python-setuptools, and updates certvalidator for Python 3.12.
